---
title: "TAOOH — primary preparation"
subtitle: "Observed weekly histories and patient-level covariates"
params:
  horizon_days: 182
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The weekly state is 1 = alive/out of hospital, 2 = planned admission,
3 = emergency room, 4 = unplanned admission, and 5 = dead. Unobserved states
remain missing. This stage constructs the observed first- and second-order
history through the requested horizon (182 days by default). Death appears
in its observed week only for fitting; empirical SOPs carry death forward
through the plotting horizon. Censored living states are never carried forward.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-taooh-data
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "taooh-helpers.R"))
horizon_days <- params$horizon_days
horizon_weeks <- taooh_horizon_weeks(horizon_days)

library(tidyverse)
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
config <- read_analysis_config()


cohort_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
taooh_input_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet"
)
output_path <- taooh_path("artifacts", horizon_days, "prepared.parquet"
)
figure_path <- taooh_path("artifacts", horizon_days, "figures",
  "empirical-state-occupancy.png"
)
dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(figure_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(cohort_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
taooh <- arrow::read_parquet(taooh_input_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

validate_taooh_follow_up(taooh, cohort)
# Keep unrestricted input intact; apply the requested fitting/plotting horizon here.
taooh <- taooh |> filter(week <= horizon_weeks)
cohort <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    survival_time_days = pmin(survival_time_days_unrestricted, horizon_days),
    event_death = as.integer(status_death_unrestricted == 1L &
                             survival_time_days_unrestricted <= horizon_days)
  )

if (any(!is.na(taooh$y_taooh) & !taooh$y_taooh %in% 1:5)) {
  stop("Observed TAOOH states must be in 1:5.")
}
  
cohort <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    ecog_fstcnt = if_else(ecog_fstcnt == 4L, 3L, ecog_fstcnt),
    diagnosis = fct_lump_n(
      factor(diagnosis),
      n = 4,
      other_level = "Other",
      ties.method = "first"
    )
  )

# Plot the observed state occupancy distribution before removing observations
# after entry into the absorbing death state for transition-model fitting.
empirical_sop_data <- cohort |>
  select(id, tx) |>
  left_join(taooh_empirical_history(taooh, horizon_days), by = "id") |>
  filter(week >= 1L) |>
  mutate(
    y_taooh = factor(
      y_taooh,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Alive/out of hospital",
        "Planned admission",
        "Emergency room",
        "Unplanned admission",
        "Dead"
      )
    ),
    tx = factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Intervention"))
  )

empirical_sop_plot <- mostr::plot_sops(
  empirical_sop_data,
  facet_var = NULL,
  time_var = "week",
  y_var = "y_taooh",
  linetype_var = "tx"
) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Observed proportion",
    color = "TAOOH state",
    linetype = "Treatment group",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  figure_path,
  empirical_sop_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

analysis_data <- cohort |>
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    age,
    gender,
    diagnosis,
    ecog_fstcnt,
    albumin,
    bilirubin,
    c_reactive_protein,
    lactate_dehydrogenase,
    survival_time_days,
    event_death
  ) |>
  left_join(taooh, by = "id") |>
  arrange(id, week) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  mutate(
    y = as.integer(y_taooh),
    yprev = if_else(week - lag(week) == 1L, lag(y), NA_integer_),
    ypprev = if_else(week - lag(week, 2L) == 2L, lag(y, 2L), NA_integer_)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(
    week >= 1L,
    !is.na(y),
    !is.na(yprev),
    !is.na(ypprev),
    yprev != 5L,
    ypprev != 5L
  ) |> 
  select(-y_taooh)

arrow::write_parquet(analysis_data, output_path, compression = "zstd")
```
